https://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/cheminf.owl fetched RDF/XML, 263827 chars, 2882 triples retained. All 29 PubChem CHEMINF terms have labels. 5 imports: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/iao.owl and http://semanticchemistry.github.io/semanticchemistry/ontology/{cdk,cheminf-algorithms,cheminf-core,cheminf-external}.owl. CDK module retrieved over HTTPS and parsed (27 triples), title CDK descriptor algorithm implementations, library CDK_000001, AtomCountDescriptor CDK_000100. User's key lesson: inspect imports for task relevance, load selectively, record unresolved dependencies, don't claim complete import closure. Do not claim imports are irrelevant merely because no direct data usage.

Focused ASK probes succeeded: IAO_0000136 predicate true; rdf:type CDK_000001 false; rdf:type CDK_000100 false; rdf:type CHEMINF_000334 true. False results scoped only to those patterns, no global absence. CHEMINF core defines parent concepts for PubChem-specific descriptors, relevant indirectly.
